summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ETC 6 Meridian Mega Cap Equity ETF (SIXA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in large-cap US equities selected from the Russell 3000 Index. SIXA was launched on May 11, 2020 and is issued by Exchange Traded Concepts.

holdings.infoBox: SIXA is an equity ETF with a total of 51 individual holdings. The top holdings are Altria Group stock at 5.22%, AT&T Inc. at 3.90%, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company at 3.75%, Verizon Communications at 3.75%, and PepsiCo at 3.69%.
